versions.content: A buffer index (BufIdx) indentifies an Ethernet buffer processed by Ethernet Driver API functions. Each controller’s buffers are identified by buffer indexes 0 to (n-1) where n is the number of buffers processed by the corresponding controller. Buffer indexes are valid within a tuple <CtrlIdx, BufIdx> only. A BufIdx uniquely identifies the buffer used for an Ethernet Driver.
